test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: To finish a work, P takes half of the number of days required by Q to finish it. If they together can finish the work in 36 days, then in how many days Q alone can finish the work?
solution:
**Given:**

P takes half of the number of days required by Q to finish the work.

P and Q together can finish the work in 36 days.

**Formula used:**

Work done together = 1/P + 1/Q

**Calculation:**

Let Q alone can finish the work in Q days.

⇒ P alone can finish the work in Q/2 days.

⇒ 1/(Q/2) + 1/Q = 1/36

⇒ 2/Q + 1/Q = 1/36

⇒ 3/Q = 1/36

⇒ Q = 36×3

⇒ Q = 108 days

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
